name: How can I tell if my windows are drafty?

mainEntity.name: How can I tell if my windows are drafty?

acceptedAnswer.text: There are several ways to detect drafty windows. You might feel cold air near windows, especially on windy days. A simple test involves holding a lit candle or an incense stick near the window frame; if the flame flickers or smoke moves horizontally, it indicates an air leak. You can also visually inspect the caulk and weatherstripping for cracks or deterioration. In some cases, a significant increase in your heating bill can also be a sign of poor window sealing.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can feel cold air, observe a flickering candle flame near the window, or visually check seals for cracks.
